Schlafkammer (bedroom) furnished in parts/room-5.mjs via one layers() call over the box [9,7,15,15,10,21]: red bed head to the back wall under the back windows, chest at the foot, barrel nightstand with lit candle, bookshelf wall with a tulip pot on the east side, brown rug, water cauldron, two hanging lanterns plus one at (9,10,18).
Room check says OK: 47/49 floor cells reachable (the 2 unreached are bookshelf cells), min light 8, 0 dark, 0 dim. Build has 0 refused and 0 off-palette writes for this part (20 placed). Rendered room.png reads as a bedroom.
make.sh stops at the roof step because roof.json (written by the Roofs part) is missing, so build.nbt was not replaced; the whole build with this part is in build.next.nbt.
left: make.sh stops with 'roof.json missing' (written by the Roofs part, not yet present), so build.nbt was not replaced; once roof.json exists, rerun ./make.sh to produce build.nbt with this room. Until then the whole build with this room is build.next.nbt.
Bedroom walk: 47 of 49 floor cells reachable; the 2 unreached cells are the bookshelf furniture at (15,7,18) and (15,7,19), not a walk problem.
plan.md checklist has no row for the room parts, and the elements.md interior item covers all six rooms, so I did not tick it; the bedroom's share is built.
check reports 4 orphan stripped_spruce_wood cells at the front and back lintels (8,14,8),(14,14,8),(8,14,22),(14,14,22); they come from the shell (part 1), not this room.
